style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: A readable crafted blue reef strip with purposeful soft teal/green and purple marine growth, coherent all-view volume, and exact continuous finite joins to the accepted reef-middle native source.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: The reef has legible blue rock volume and intentional coral grouping. Native form improvements replace the broad blank slab and isolated peg reading, within the exact finite interfaces and reef-edge's own envelope. Preserve identity and palette family while allowing new forms, proportions, construction, decoration and part counts.

Broad soft highlight-to-midtone transitions distinguish cyan/blue support, teal/green focal growth and purple supporting growth. Local dark openings communicate depth. Avoid a broad black lower band, muddy merged groups, clipped white glints, bright decorative noise or a visible artificial silhouette rim.

Both actual W/E cuts and their neighboring surface bands continue into accepted middle modules without a visible crack, light/dark stripe, profile step, exposed cap or fringe in every required facing and actual consumer phase. Measured geometry, evaluated triangle/corner normals, native albedo/material graphs and common lights must establish continuity beyond profile names.

Selected larger openings, branching or grouped marine forms and crafted stone shapes enrich the asset while remaining readable at cell128 and phone32. Neither original part counts nor every painted target caustic/ornament is a requirement.
All four facings have useful volume and a coherent silhouette. No floating ornaments, damaging intersections, coplanar flashes, clipped geometry, hidden image plane or directional ground shadow.
